# ckbadger LLM Capability Map

Site purpose:

- CKB-native explorer focused on exact on-chain data.

Markdown output convention:

- Any page URL can be requested as markdown by appending `.md`.
- Response content-type: `text/markdown`.
- Markdown YAML frontmatter includes `buildVersion`.
- Examples:
  - `/blocks.md`
  - `/blocks/123.md`
  - `/tx/0xabc...def.md`
  - `/charts/transaction-count.md`

Raw output convention:

- Raw format can be requested with:
  - suffix: `.raw`
  - query: `?format=raw`
  - accept: `application/vnd.ckbadger.raw+json`
- Negotiation priority: `query.format` > `path suffix` > `Accept` header.
- Raw profile is selected with query param: `profile=default|debugger`
- Current raw routes:
  - `/blocks/{id}.raw` (profile: `default`)
  - `/cell/{outpoint}.raw` (profile: `default`)
  - `/identities/dotbit/{identityId}.raw` (profile: `default`)
  - `/identities/did/{identityId}.raw` (profile: `default`)
  - `/objects/mnft/{objectId}.raw` (profile: `default`)
  - `/tx/{hash}.raw` (profiles: `default`, `debugger`)
- `profile=debugger` includes `data.txDebugger.mockTransaction`, compatible with `ckb-debugger --tx-file`.
- `/tx/{hash}.raw` includes `data.txWitness` with witness analyses, script-group lens, and inference.
- Raw `meta` includes `buildVersion`.
- Raw responses include headers: `x-ckbadger-format`, `x-ckbadger-profile`, `x-ckbadger-schema`.

Known markdown page routes:

- `/`
- `/address/{addr}`
- `/assets`
- `/blocks`
- `/blocks/{id}`
- `/cell/{outpoint}`
- `/charts`
- `/charts/{slug}`
- `/clusters/{clusterId}`
- `/dao`
- `/dao/charts`
- `/forks`
- `/forks/{id}`
- `/hardforks`
- `/identities/{collectionId}`
- `/identities/dotbit/{identityId}`
- `/identities/did/{identityId}`
- `/objects`
- `/objects/{sporeId}`
- `/objects/mnft/{objectId}`
- `/script/{codeHash}`
- `/scripts`
- `/scripts/{name}`
- `/tokens`
- `/tokens/{typeHash}`
- `/transactions`
- `/tx/{hash}`

Chart slugs:

- `address-cohort-retention`
- `average-block-time`
- `block-time-distribution`
- `capacity-turnover-ratio`
- `cell-count`
- `cell-size-distribution`
- `circulation-ratio`
- `common-knowledge-composition`
- `daily-deposit`
- `difficulty`
- `epoch-time-distribution`
- `epoch-time-length`
- `hash-rate`
- `hodl-wave`
- `inflation-rate`
- `knowledge-size`
- `miner-address-distribution`
- `most-utilized-assets`
- `most-utilized-scripts`
- `nominal-apc`
- `secondary-issuance`
- `total-deposit`
- `total-supply`
- `transaction-count`
- `uncle-rate`

API:

- Base URL: `/api/v1`
- JSON API supports blocks, transactions, cells, scripts, tokens, charts, DAO, forks, hardfork timeline.
- Capability descriptor: `/capabilities` (formats, profiles, route matrix, and strict error codes).

Notes for agents:

- Prefer markdown pages for narrative + tabular summaries.
- Prefer `/api/v1` for structured machine extraction and full-fidelity fields.
- Use markdown page query params for pagination when supported: `limit`, `cursor`.
